Definition: from G3691; vinegar, i.e. sour wine:--vinegar.
BiblicalUsage: Vinegar is the sour wine offered at the cross. The soldiers offered Jesus vinegar to drink as He hung there, and John says there was a vessel full of vinegar, and they filled a sponge with it and put it to His mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vinegar is the last bitterness of the cross: they gave Him sour wine when He thirsted, and He drank it and finished the work.
